bindings.name: presentation_pseudonym
bindings.source: envelope:presentationBinding.pseudonym — MUST equal the envelope presentation binding pseudonym; an anonymous-profile envelope omits that key and the expected value is the sentinel 0.

bindings.name: scope_id
bindings.source: envelope:presentationBinding.scopeId — MUST equal the envelope binding scope; under the scoped profile the verifier MUST additionally recompute the scope from its APR-authenticated identity and declared scopePolicy; an anonymous-profile envelope omits that key and the expected value is the sentinel 0.

bindings.name: claim_binding
bindings.note: compute_selective_disclosure_binding: a typed transcript folding flags and values as position-labelled pairs, so a disclosed zero differs from a hidden slot and moving a value changes the transcript.

bindings.name: proof_context
bindings.source: context:value — MUST equal the authenticated request context hash for this presentation.

bindings.name: accumulator_root
bindings.source: policy:accumulatorState.roots[accumulatorEpoch] — selective disclosure additionally REQUIRES the root to come from authenticated metadata-v2 ingestion; an unauthenticated root MUST be rejected.

bindings.name: accumulator_epoch
bindings.source: policy:accumulatorState — MUST NOT lag the verifier's current epoch view by more than the policy epoch-lag bound, and MUST NOT be ahead of that view.

bindings.name: timestamp
bindings.source: context:timestamp — MUST equal the authenticated request context timestamp.

bindings.name: current_epoch
bindings.source: policy:accumulatorState.currentEpoch — MUST equal the verifier's own current accumulator epoch view for the proof's issuer.

bindings.name: issuer_public_key_x
bindings.source: policy:issuerAllowlist — the (x, y) key MUST be an exact member of the verifier trust policy's issuer allowlist, and the matched issuer MUST be trusted for this proof type.

bindings.name: issuer_public_key_y
bindings.source: policy:issuerAllowlist — checked together with issuer_public_key_x as one exact allowlist key.

bindings.name: credential_attribute_count
bindings.justification: A property of the credential, not of the request: the issuer signature verified in-circuit covers the credential digest, whose preimage includes this count, so the prover cannot claim a count the issuer never attested. The verifier MUST still range-check it (1..8) and reject any disclosure mask selecting a padding position at or beyond it.

bindings.name: disclosure_count
bindings.note: MUST equal the population count of disclosed_flags and be at least 1.

bindings.name: disclosed_flags
bindings.source: param:disclosedPositions — the mask MUST equal exactly the positions the authenticated request asked to be disclosed; a proof disclosing more, fewer, or different positions MUST be rejected.

bindings.name: disclosed_attributes
bindings.justification: These are the proof's output — the attribute values the verifier is learning — so no request-side expectation exists by design. Authenticity is enforced in-circuit: disclosed slots MUST equal the issuer-signed credential attributes, hidden slots are forced to 0, and the values are committed by the typed disclosure transcript (claim_binding).
